Subject: Recap: Pilot qualification + recommended model slate (next steps & perf links)

Hi Maya — thanks for the time today. Quick written recap from our discovery so we have alignment and clear next steps for the pilot.

What we heard
- Primary goal: accurate, low-latency summarization of clinical visit notes at scale for NovaHealth's triage flow.
- Throughput target: sustained ~120 tokens/sec for batch inference while keeping p95 latency under ~350ms for single-request flows.
- Data: de-identified notes (1000 samples for initial regression checks).

Redwood's recommended model slate (pilot):
1) Redstone-3.2 (quantized 4-bit profile) — best balance for your abstractive summaries; expected p50 ~120ms, p95 ~330ms on our dedicated 4x A100 pool; target throughput ~140 TPS with continuous batching.
2) Llama-2-70b-chat (int8) — higher quality on edge cases; p50 ~220ms, p95 ~520ms; throughput ~60 TPS.
3) Redwood-compact-13b (optimized) — lowest-cost fallback for high-volume short summaries; p50 ~95ms, p95 ~260ms; throughput ~220 TPS.

Why this mix
- Redstone-3.2 covers most accuracy needs while staying within your latency SLO. Llama-70b is a quality hedge. The compact model keeps unit costs controlled for bulk processing.

Evidence & artifacts attached/linked
- Attached: redwood_verified_profiles_Q3_2026.pdf (per-model TPS/latency percentiles, trace examples).
- Attached: novahealth_prompt_set_v1.jsonl (example prompt/ground-truth pairs we discussed).
- Attached: pilot_mutual_action_plan.xlsx (roles, milestones, success metrics).
- Benchmarks: https://redwood-inference.com/benchmarks/RDW-3247 (detailed traces & per-sequence heatmaps).

Open concerns we flagged on the call
- Potential quality regressions around rare entity hallucinations for oncology-specific shorthand — Marissa to run a small regression suite once NovaHealth shares the sample dataset.
- Mixed-length sequences (very long notes + short triage notes) may change batching efficiency; we recommend a short profiling run with representative traffic.

Proposed next steps (please confirm):
1) NovaHealth: share de-identified sample set (target by 2026-09-27).
2) Redwood: run regression checks + produce a short perf snapshot (3 business days after we receive samples).
3) Pilot kickoff window: propose Oct 4–8 for initial deployment and tuning.
4) Decision point: after 2 weeks of pilot, review quality/regression report and decide on Dedicated vs Hosted for POC.

If that all looks right I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff and loop in our infra lead for capacity planning.

Thanks — Jordan
